# Atlas Robotics - Q3 FY2026 operating review (internal)

Prepared by the office of the CFO. Figures are unaudited.

## Revenue

Q3 revenue was **$41.6M**, against $33.9M in Q2 and $28.4M in Q3 last year.
Services accounted for $9.2M of the Q3 total; hardware for the remaining $32.4M.

The Northwind contract alone contributed $6.1M, and renews in January.

## Costs

Cost of goods sold was $22.9M. Operating expenses were $14.2M, of which $5.8M was
R&D headcount and $3.1M was the Fremont facility lease.

## Headcount

We ended the quarter with 312 employees, up from 287 at the end of Q2. Attrition was
4.1%, the lowest in eight quarters.

## Commentary

The VP of Operations, Dana Whitfield, put it plainly in the September review:

> "We are shipping more units with fewer escalations than at any point since the
> Series B. The constraint is no longer the line - it is the field engineers."

## Risks

Two customers represent 31% of revenue. The Fremont lease expires in July 2027 and the
landlord has signalled a 20% increase at renewal.
